data.one_liner: Efficiently derive memoized data from your Redux store or other state
data.what_it_does: Provides selector functions to compute derived data from a single input like a Redux store. Caches results and only recomputes when input arguments change. Allows composing multiple selectors together.
use_when: You are using Redux and need to compute expensive derived data from state
You want to keep your Redux state minimal by deriving views of data on the fly
You need to compose multiple data selectors efficiently without unnecessary recalculations
avoid_when: Your application is small and simple functions are enough
You are using a state management solution that already has built-in derivation and memoization like Riverpod
strengths: Memoizes derived computations to prevent redundant work
Composable selectors that can be combined like building blocks
Customizable memoization functions for different comparison strategies
weaknesses: Adds an extra layer of abstraction that is unnecessary for small applications

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Riverpod provides built-in state derivation and caching via providers, serving as a complete modern state management and dependency injection solution.

alternatives.name: flutter_riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers built-in reactive data derivation and caching integrated directly with Flutter widgets.
